event: Nala turns Shaestrel round and starts on the hooks at her nape.
Nala undoes the hooks one by one, kissing her back as she goes down, an inch at a time.
Shaestrel goes still, and her breath changes as Nala works down her spine.
The last hook gives at the waist, and Shaestrel holds the bodice to her front.
She says, unsteady, that Nala will want to hang the gown up.
She lets the gown go, and it pools grey-green on the floorboards.
She turns round and pulls Nala's face down to hers.
